chain_words.nuance: taking little time, often for a short action
moving or working at high speed
increasing or happening at great speed
very quick and smooth in movement
faster than the speed of sound

explanation: These words all express high speed, from a quick action to movement faster than sound.

usage_notes.difference: 'Quick' often describes a short action or a brief time; 'fast' describes a high rate of movement or speed in general.
